p.d: When the King falls ill, Shrek finds and trains an heir apparent while Princess Fiona fends off Prince Charming's advances.
After Rumpelstiltskin tricks him into making a pact, Shrek finds himself in an alternate version of Far Far Away, in which he and Fiona never met.
A factory worker (Colin Farrell) becomes a hunted man after a procedure goes awry that would convert his dreams of life as a spy into real memories.

Perseus (Sam Worthington) enlists the aid of Queen Andromeda (Rosamund Pike), Hephaestus (Bill Nighy) and Poseidon's son (Toby Kebbell) to rescue Zeus (Liam Neeson) from the underworld, defeat the Titans and save mankind.
To save his kidnapped wife, a former race-car driver (Ethan Hawke) must follow the instructions of a man (Jon Voight) who is watching his every move through a hidden camera.
A veteran hit-man contends with a crazy upstart and bad memories while embarking on his final assignment.
A mysterious operative (Zoe Saldana) joins forces with a group of elite commandos (Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Chris Evans), as they hunt the man who organized a lethal betrayal against them.
While on a tour of the White House with his young daughter, a Capitol policeman springs into action to save his child and protect the president from a heavily armed group of paramilitary invaders.
Eight years after he took the blame for Harvey Dent's death and vanished into the night, Batman is forced out of his self-imposed exile by a cunning cat burglar and a merciless terrorist called Bane.
